newsitem.title: USA: Southeast U.S. business conditions balanced - Rogers.
newsitem.headline: Southeast U.S. business conditions balanced - Rogers.

text.p: Business conditions in the southeastern United States appear balanced despite a December decline in manufacturing, said Marc Rogers, an economist at the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta.

"The weakness was fairly moderate and ... we've been on a low growth trajectory," Rogers said in an interview with Reuters Financial Television. "Overall it looks like we have a relatively balanced picture for the Southeast."
Thanks in part to the moderate pace of manufacturing expansion in the Southeast, inflation remains under control, Rogers said.
"There are very few, if any, signs of a pickup in inflation at the manufacturing level," he said.
Future performance in manufacturing in both the Southeast and the rest of the nation depends on the health of consumer balance sheets, Rogers said.
"We need to pay a little bit more attention to the consumer sector, not just in the Southeast but nationally," the economist said.
